_doctrine: R-023: the baseline contract. Deck 1 BEATS = what a PLAIN tutorial on this concept would minimally need (derived from the concept, not the inventory); each beat is a ROLE cast with one artifact (alts = understudies). Deck 2 VOLTAGE = the few pieces a plain tutorial would never include -- the critical script, the thinker with QFEP. Everything uncast is AT DEPTH: kept, honored by the dig line, not needed by the book or the walk.

voltage.why: constraint as the given world you did not choose — the lattice's occupancy threshold is set before you arrive; you inhabit whether it percolates, you did not decide it
the past determines the next — each carved cell is chosen only from the current state; the walk has no plan, only history, and the cave is what history leaves behind
Deleuze's rhizome — non-hierarchical growth with no center and no author; the space assembles itself from local connection, authorship-without-an-author made walkable

generation as authorship-without-an-author — creatures evolve toward a fitness goal no individual understands; the proof is that structure arrives without a designer, the QFEP potential realizing itself
